proposal.reason: Substantive changes are in GitHub review/merge automation: review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py now enforce module Reviewer+Maintainer requirements with command-driven overrides, new review-command/review-module/review-gate/review-squash-preview workflows rewire routing and gate triggers, and commit_message_squash.py ties squash preview publication/removal to gate state. Other edits (skill text/modules roster/docs/renames) support this same review-policy workflow change rather than independent module behavior.
